title: Pick the Hook
goal: Great games HOOK you in. Each thing in a game makes you feel something.
mascot_lines: Why do some games glue you to the screen?
Each thing in a game makes you feel something.
Match the game thing to the feeling it gives you!

tier2.rephrase: Each game feature makes the player feel a feeling. Match them up.

tier3.nudge: Power-ups make you feel POWERFUL. Surprises make you CURIOUS. Tough bosses make you PROUD when you win.
